Name: Evil Fabricated
Author: EvilWish995
Description:
Hello farmer,
You have been chosen to test our latest technological advances. You start from the bottom, maybe build a survival miner or use our new ways to produce hardwood. In the end, it's up to you. Let me explain some new aspects. 
Let's start with the equipment that will be available to you for the time being:
- Clay Mixer
- Small Well
- Dirt Collector
- Woddhardener
- Simple Mixer
- Millstone
- Survival Miner
- Survival Furnace
- Steam Engine
- Steam Macerator
- Steam Alloy Smelter
- Steam Furnace 
- Steam Press
Of course, you also have completely new objects at your disposal, but listing them is beyond the scope of this article.
Let me explain some basic concepts to make it easier for you to get started.
ATTENTION::::: RECOMMENDED IS THE USE OF Automate and PFM Automate
Clay Production:
Small Bowl -> Small Well -> Water Bottle -> Clay Mixer
Dirt Collector -> Dirt Clump -> Clay Mixer
When the Clay Mixer receives both ingredients, it creates clay
[img width=214,height=236]https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1009742/description_e8e04cce-0380-4df6-abf4-e8105e250f23.png[/img]
Bronze Line:
IMPORTANT: You can use normal Copper ore for crushed copper!
[img width=117,height=129]https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1009742/description_780e7590-d7ee-427d-83e8-39df27835026.png[/img]
Steam Setup:
[img width=117,height=129]https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1009742/description_924f32bb-eb6f-4375-b901-0a8d059d9436.png[/img]
Survival Miner:
The Survival Miner is slower than a 16 year old donkey, but it opens the way to tin which you need for bronze.
So I hope that explains some basics.
On behalf of the Evil Faction, it gives me great pleasure to welcome you to the Alpha Project. Your tasks are simple, you find mistakes? Report them to us. You find something unbalanced? Report it to us. You have other problems? Report them to us.
I am also pleased to show you the roadmap for the future:
- Coming very soon. Wiki on the logic of the machines
- Steam expansion (crafter, circuit, new ores)
- Simpe Electric Age (Electric Machines, New Ore Conveyors, More Alloys etc.)
- More Quality of Life Content
- And much more

So I hope I could give you a short insight. 
Don't forget if you have any questions or problems -> let us know
With kind regards 
1st class researcher
Evilcoding
Evil Faction
